environment.cpu: Intel Xeon E312xx (Sandy Bridge, IBRS update)

methodology.scope: Local loopback HTTP, deterministic synthetic content, isolated process per scenario; no production traffic
methodology.rawSourceBaseline: Raw local file; anonymization and gzip repeated every request; no transformed-result cache. Not a complete legacy deployment comparison.
methodology.measurements: Cold request then 3 warmups, 2 batches each at concurrency 1 (16 requests) and 8 (32 requests). CPU and RSS include server, loopback client, hashing and Node runtime; worker-thread CPU included. First cold request also includes worker startup when applicable.
methodology.limitations: Warm OS page cache; no TLS, proxy, GitHub bandwidth, database auth or real-world RTT. Small sample p95 is descriptive, not a capacity SLA. Fresh metadata indexes; not a full-size index test.

assertions: All 2200 response bodies verified against expected output or the validated wire digest
